rationale:
Fresh independent review of the unchanged candidate at sha256:88e15cc7b72f19c64c6131fb5bf805f3368723139d0a514232e406b3a056de8b (authz-012, no-mutation retry of authz-011). The plan is internally consistent with the hardened design, implementation-ready, strictly test-driven (fail-first per task), zero-dependency Node ESM, and fail-closed at every persistence, gate, provenance, journal, replay, and export boundary.

Authority boundaries are preserved exactly: model consensus is never authorization; The Eye alone authorizes exact roots; Grok/Gemini are mandatory only inside profile P2/C2 and remain advisory in the existing TELOS council; the required TELOS trio stays claude/agy/codex; agy stays outside the v1 profile; council approval certifies submission only and cannot start Task 1 or mutate CURRENT-AUTHORITY.json. Preconditions correctly demand a fresh Eye grant bound to this plan root, plugin checkout, and tasks 1-11 before any implementation write.

Pass-or-return, no automatic caps, forbidden seat substitution, signed append-only Merkle-DAG coverage for every pass/non-pass/death/mutation/retry/invalidation/Eye action, crash-atomic journals with CAS fencing, disk-only replay as sole derived state, separate implementation-artifact vs embedded tree-root binding, Icarus-only lifecycle-round checkpoint ownership before precompact, closed typed envelopes with credential/private-reasoning rejection, injected provider doubles, and detached-verifiable handoff (synthetic-test vs production) are all specified with negative controls sufficient to re-derive canonical artifacts, signatures, provenance, gate order, disk truth, and the TELOS export from disk. Source target is the plugin checkout; cache is never source. No concrete defect requires revision before submission to The Eye.
